description: Image Description: The image features several plastic bottles of honey, some of which are shaped like bears. Each bottle has a yellow cap. The bear-shaped bottle is prominently displayed in the foreground, with a label that reads "COUNTRY BEES Honey Farm" and "Orange Blossom." The label also includes an address in Lakeland, Florida. The honey inside is a rich amber color. In the background, there are more bottles, some with similar yellow caps, indicating that they are also likely honey containers
